Convolution is $O(n^3)$ due to the triple summation in the transfer matrix [S1].

The claim states that convolution is $O(n^3)$ due to the triple summation in the transfer matrix. Source [S1] explicitly provides the formula for the SH projection of multiplication (convolution) as $(a * b)_i = sum_{j=1}^{n} sum_{k=1}^{n} C_{ijk} a_j b_k$. This formula involves a double summation over indices $j$ and $k$ for each output index $i$. Since there are $n$ output coefficients (index $i$ ranges from 1 to $n$), the total number of operations is proportional to $n 	imes n 	imes n = n^3$. The term $C_{ijk}$ is identified as the transfer matrix. Thus, the evidence supports the claim that the complexity is $O(n^3)$ due to the summations involving the transfer matrix indices.
